main_body: Three stacked horizontal wooden slats/trays with posts between them, one of which holds pots and an orange item. All parts are drawn face-on as a flat front view.
top_band: none. At x=15 the scan reads an outline at row 0, then a 1-row highlight (L=98) at row 1, then dark brown face rows 2-3. No multi-row lighter horizontal surface sits above the front face.
evidence: The upper plank (rows 0-4) is one highlight row plus a dark face and outline, which is a thin rim rather than a top surface. The middle tray (rows 7-16) and the lower plank (rows 19-23) are likewise flat vertical faces with a 1-row highlight at the top. None of the major parts shows a horizontal surface seen from above. The pots and the orange item are painted on the face, not seen into an opening. This matches the red front-elevation case in the guide.

style.evidence: The candidate has 18 colours per 16x16 tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and 0% flat-fill coverage. Its dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood. The wood ramp runs from about L=36 through 64, 72, 98 and 131 to the light brown highlights, roughly 5 steps, with grain dots and highlights. Its total of 18 distinct colours is lower than the references' 38-40, but this is a small piece and the per-tile richness matches them.
